title: radar-brief/1
description: An analyst brief drafted from one context file (JSON Schema draft 2020-12). Every free-text field is a claim that cites the ids of the context items it rests on. The screen (spec/screen_rules.json) checks what a schema cannot: figures, wording, citations, confidence and the fixed lines.

headline.description: Neutral, a lead and not a finding; it must say 'not a finding'.

uk.description: What rose in the UK figures.

onward.description: What the onward figures show, passed or not.

why_it_may_be_ordinary.description: Why the rise may be ordinary trade, from the context's limits.

note.description: What the cases summary says: how the cases link, and that they named no UK goods or UK party. Never the case outcomes.

question.description: The red flag's question, word for word.

limits.description: Ids of the context limits that apply; the page shows their text from the context.

responds_to_review.description: One answer per reviewer note in the prompt's review notes: what this draft changed because of it, or why it could not. Left out when there are no notes.

house_line.description: Exactly: A rise in exports is a lead, not evidence of a breach.

ogl_line.description: Exactly: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
